capture: Chromium CDP screencast with real frame timestamps; no virtual time or state writes
input: Ordinary browser keyboard/mouse events, automatically operated

ordinaryConveyorAssembly.receiptHashEncoding: SHA256 of actual final banks serialized as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and unescaped Unicode; value hashes, not original JSON byte-substring hashes.
ordinaryConveyorAssembly.scope: Actual A/B edges, detached action and wrap banks, permanent part identities and sparse current exclusive-owner endpoints. Each observed lastStep is the actual complete one-tick interval, including the winning interval; actual host/model ticks are retained without an invented transaction counter. Terminal inventories stay unchanged in later observations. Local endpoint/receipt identities do not replace the complete ordinary independent audit. Missing transient lastAction values and sampling gaps remain explicit; no unobserved trajectory, input, transfer or ownership state is reconstructed. Menu preparation never advances the model.

encodingOrderEvidence.scope: Original reception order and frame bytes retained; derived encoding order is stable by recorded timestamp with reception-index ties. No state or frame is synthesized by this consolidation.

observationScope: Actual browser inputs, detached action/wrap receipts, permanent part identities and sparse unique-owner conveyor endpoints. Every active call retains its complete actual tick, including winning and fault-limit calls. Local receipt/ownership/endpoint checks do not replace the full ordinary independent audit. Sampling gaps and unobserved transient lastAction values remain explicit; no missing trajectory, input or transfer is reconstructed. Strategy diagnostics are excluded from gameplay evidence. The approved recipe is hash-bound; actual win and terminal hold come from observations. Raw reception-order and derived encoding manifests and real empty error arrays are retained. Existing full decode is reused once. Original/final ordinary corpora and both candidate layout failures retain their own source hashes; no recording recovery is assumed. No physical-device test is claimed.

ordinaryCaseSourceHistory.scope: The original six successful cases remain historical. Six affected cases under the reviewed navigation-stop hysteresis correction establish the final pilot corpus. Both preserve raw/source hashes; each active call retains one complete actual tick including terminal calls. Public projections remove only top-level pilotDiagnostics. No game is rerun for consolidation.

preservedFailedAttempts.scope: Actual complete win retained; later 960x540 menu containment failed.

candidateAttemptHistory.scope: Two original candidate failures and exact renderer layout corrections retain their own build/source hashes. Third candidate establishes final-source acceptance. These are candidate attempts, not recording failures or recovery claims.

encodedSelectionScope: Nine unmodified encoded images from actual periodic observations: three stable menus, a currently rotated held part, actual near-win streak, an occupied socket, completed output history, moving belts and observed win after at least two seconds of terminal hold. Narrow current-state predicates reserve distinct samples before broad motion/history picks; extraction is sorted by actual selected time. Current ownership and orientation are checked against actual parts/slots and permanent action receipts; no snapshot is assigned a predicted future capture state. Every terminal lastStep contains its real one-tick interval; host tick and model tick are separately retained without inventing transactionCount. A missing sample stops extraction; no post-dispatch edge selection, extra Model run, recapture or automatic replacement. Original received order and the complete stable encoding-order mapping remain bound. The recommended gameplay frame is only a candidate for the later cover, never copied into source here. Every image semantic awaits personal review.
